chain.title: An Empty Promise
chain.desc: Crafted from leather and string, and is the base for every tier and ability upgrade.

chain.title: Glass and Iron Bladder
chain.desc: Crafted from iron ingots and colorless glass, and can be built directly into a backpack or applied later.

chain.title: Rolled and Ready
chain.desc: Crafted from white wool, and can be shift-right-clicked onto a placed backpack to attach or swap it.

chain.title: Everything on Your Shoulders
chain.desc: Crafted from leather, string, a wooden chest, two backpack tanks and a sleeping bag, and also generates rarely in dungeon, mineshaft and desert pyramid chests.

chain.title: Brass Tip
chain.desc: Crafted from iron and gold ingots as the head of the hose.

chain.title: Drink, Draw, Douse
chain.desc: Crafted from a hose nozzle and green dye, and switches between suck, spill and drink modes while a backpack is equipped.

chain.title: Retrofitting the Reservoirs
chain.desc: Crafted from a blank upgrade and a backpack tank to add fluid tanks to a backpack that was built without them.

chain.title: Bench on the Trail
chain.desc: Crafted from a blank upgrade, a wooden chest and a crafting table.

chain.title: Nothing Left Behind
chain.desc: Crafted from a blank upgrade, redstone dust and a hopper.

chain.title: Ironclad Interior
chain.desc: Crafted from a blank upgrade ringed with iron ingots to expand the backpack's inventory to the iron tier.

chain.title: Embers in the Pack
chain.desc: Crafted from a blank upgrade, a wooden chest and a furnace.

chain.title: Reach Without Walking
chain.desc: Crafted from a blank upgrade, iron, lapis, redstone and an ender pearl.

chain.title: The Bottomless Slot
chain.desc: Crafted from a blank upgrade, redstone dust and a lava bucket to delete unwanted items on pickup.

chain.title: Gold-Lined Pockets
chain.desc: Crafted from a blank upgrade ringed with gold ingots to expand the backpack to the gold tier.

chain.title: It Feeds You Back
chain.desc: Crafted from a blank upgrade, redstone, a golden apple and a golden carrot.

chain.title: Ore Melts Faster Here
chain.desc: Crafted from a blank upgrade, a wooden chest and a blast furnace.

chain.title: Facets of Space
chain.desc: Crafted from a blank upgrade ringed with diamonds to expand the backpack to the diamond tier.

chain.title: The Stack Never Ends
chain.desc: Crafted from a blank upgrade, redstone dust and a dropper to top up hotbar stacks from the backpack.

chain.title: Last Expansion
chain.desc: Made in a smithing table from a blank upgrade, a netherite upgrade template and a netherite ingot for the highest inventory tier.

chain.title: Ash-Black Traveler
chain.desc: Made in a smithing table from the diamond backpack, a netherite upgrade template and a netherite ingot.

notes: All ids verified against assets/travelersbackpack/models/item/*.json intersected with item./block. lang keys (80 items). Progression derived from data/travelersbackpack/recipes/** (140 recipe files) plus data/travelersbackpack/loot_modifiers/**. Key structure: blank_upgrade (leather+string) is the root of every upgrade; inventory size is driven by the four *_tier_upgrade items (iron/gold/diamond ingots ringing a blank upgrade, netherite via smithing_transform), NOT by the themed backpacks. The ~60 themed backpacks (bee, blaze, cow, diamond, emerald, ...) are cosmetic variants crafted with the custom 'backpack_shaped' type from travelersbackpack:standard plus a theme ingredient; each also has a *_smithing recipe (type 'backpack_upgrade') that re-skins an existing backpack using the travelersbackpack:backpack_upgrades tag. Dropped ids: hose_drink, hose_spill, hose_suck and supporter_star (models exist but no matching item./block. lang key, so they failed set-membership). Excluded from the chain but real items: travelersbackpack:travelers_backpack (a generic block entry with no recipe), and the three loot-only themed backpacks bat (mineshaft/dungeon chests), iron_golem (armorer village chests) and villager (librarian trade only) - the jar states these obtain methods in its own obtain.travelersbackpack.* lang keys. The 16 *_sleeping_bag colours are all real and craftable from wool or by dyeing. No unverifiable ids were written.
